summary.text: Cindi Ward is the Republican candidate for Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 103 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Nate Davidson (D).
A realtor and former East Pennsboro Area School District board member, she also ran for the seat in 2024, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Ward was born in Liberty, New York, and earned an associate degree from Sullivan County Community College in 2000, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her profession as real estate.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey she said she had lived in Pennsylvania for more than 29 years, 27 of them in Enola, had worked as a realtor for 16 years, and had previously worked as a preschool teacher and assistant preschool director and as a school bus driver.

Ward served on the East Pennsboro Area School District board as an at-large member, and in her 2024 survey she also described roles on the Cumberland Perry Area Career & Technical Center's Joint Operating Committee and the East Pennsboro Township recreation board.
Ward was the Republican candidate for District 103 in 2024, when Nate Davidson (D) won the open seat with 60.4% of the vote to her 39.3%.
In that survey she listed strengthening the economy and lowering taxes among her key messages.
